service.description: Fetch the branch of a remote kind repository from its remoteUrl into its bare mirror, created by the first fetch. The local branch is replaced by the remote one. Records lastFetchDate, lastFetchError and headCommitId on the repository. Refused in sim mode.

Fetch every remote kind repository whose fetchIntervalMinutes has passed since its lastFetchDate (for the fetch_AllGitRepositories_frequent ServiceJob). A repository that fails has its error recorded and logged, and the others are still fetched.
Make a repository ready: create the bare repository of a local kind (a local repository is also created on its first use), fetch a remote kind for the first time. A db kind needs nothing.
Write a db kind repository as a bare repository on disk, with its branch and HEAD, so it can be cloned and pushed with the git command line. Object ids are the same as in the database.

parameter.name: targetPath
parameter.description: Relative to the runtime directory unless absolute; the repository's localPath (default runtime/git/repositoryId) when empty

service.description: Copy a branch, with all of its history, into a db kind repository, replacing its branch.

parameter.name: source
parameter.description: git://otherRepositoryId, a repository directory (bare or not), or a URL to fetch (HTTPS; file and ssh run the system git and ssh); the repository's remoteUrl when empty

service.description: The branches and tags of a repository, each with the commit it names and, for an annotated tag, the tag object.

parameter.name: refType
parameter.description: branch or tag; all refs when empty

parameter.name: refList
parameter.description: Maps: refName, shortName, refType (branch, tag, other), objectId, isDefault, annotated, commitId, summary, commitDate, authorName, tag (tagName, targetId, targetType, message, taggerName, taggerEmail, taggerDate)

service.description: Commits reachable from a revision, newest commit date first.

parameter.name: revision
parameter.description: A branch or tag name, a full ref name, or a commit id or prefix; the default branch when empty

parameter.name: path
parameter.description: Only the commits that changed this path against their first parent

parameter.name: afterCommitId
parameter.description: Start after this commit: the last commitId of the previous page

parameter.name: limit
parameter.description: At most 500

parameter.name: commitList
parameter.description: Maps: commitId, shortId, treeId, parentIds, authorName, authorEmail, authorDate, committerName, committerEmail, committerDate, summary, body, message, trailers (a Map of name to a List of values), moquiUserId

service.description: A commit and the files it changed against its first parent (every file for a root commit). No commit out when the revision names no commit.

parameter.name: commitId
parameter.description: A commit id or a unique prefix of at least 4 hex digits, or a branch or tag name

parameter.name: stats
parameter.description: Count inserted and deleted lines of each file

parameter.name: commit
parameter.description: As each map of get#GitLog commitList

parameter.name: fileList
parameter.description: Maps: path, changeType (added, modified, deleted), oldObjectId, newObjectId, and with stats binary, tooLarge, insertions, deletions

service.description: The line diff of each file a commit changed, or of one file. A binary file, or a side over 1 MB, has no diff.

parameter.name: fileDiffList
parameter.description: Maps as get#GitCommit fileList, with unifiedDiff and html (an escaped moqui-diff table, for a render-mode text type="html,qvt") for a text file

service.description: The file at a path in a revision; no out parameters when it is not a file there.

parameter.name: text
parameter.description: A UTF-8 file without NUL bytes

parameter.name: bytes
parameter.description: Any other file

service.description: The URLs to clone a repository with: HTTPS from the git_public_url property (else the webapp host and port properties) and, when the SSH server is on, SSH with the current user's username, from ssh_public_host and ssh_public_port (else the webapp host and ssh_port).

Commit files on the default branch of a local or db repository in one commit, with a message, as the current user (with the Moqui-User-Id trailer). Needs AT_GIT_REPOSITORY update on the repository. A gitECA rule with source write sees it.

parameter.name: fileMap
parameter.description: Path to its new text (or bytes)

parameter.name: commitId
parameter.description: Empty when nothing changed

service.description: Delete the objects of db kind repositories that no ref reaches (and no change in progress or of the last git_gc_reflog_days days needs) and that were not written or referenced in the last git_gc_prune_days days; then repack: store the versions of each path as deltas of each other, the newest whole, compress rows written before the zlib format, and make delta chains deeper than git_db_delta_depth shorter (for the gc_GitRepositories_daily ServiceJob). A repository whose refs reach a missing object is not collected. A repository that fails has its error recorded (lastGcResult) and logged, and the others still run.

parameter.name: repositoryId
parameter.description: Every db repository when empty

parameter.name: dryRun
parameter.description: Count what would be deleted and change nothing

parameter.name: timeoutMinutes
parameter.description: When repacking stops; the deletes are done first

parameter.name: results
parameter.description: A Map per repository: repositoryId, deletedCount, deletedBytes, repackedCount, savedBytes, objectCount, storedBytes, summary, or error

service.description: Decode every object of a db kind repository (applying its deltas) and check it against its id, and that every ref points to an object that is there. An error names the damaged objects.
Run the gitECA post events (ref-update, commit, tag, post-receive) of a pending GitUpdate, as the user who made it. Nothing when it is not pending (it ran, or another worker has it).

Run the post events of every pending GitUpdate, after putting back the ones a restart cut short (for the process_PendingGitUpdates_frequent ServiceJob). One that fails is recorded on its row and logged, and the others still run.
